text: 10 OVERDOSAGE Overdosage of estrogen plus progestogen may cause nausea, vomiting, breast tenderness, abdominal pain, drowsiness and fatigue, and withdrawal bleeding may occur in women. Treatment of overdose consists of discontinuation of Mimvey therapy with institution of appropriate symptomatic care.
